text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the veterinary team, noting that doctors and support staff demonstrate exceptional warmth, professionalism, and continuity of care. Long-time clients highlight Dr. Hernandez, Dr. Taddeo, and receptionist Aissa for their gentle approach and clear guidance. Reviewers also appreciate thoughtful gestures, such as receiving handwritten sympathy cards during difficult moments of pet loss.

Reviewers frequently emphasize how comfortably pets are treated during examinations and treatments at this Queens hospital. Clients mention that clinicians take time to help dogs and cats relax before beginning physical checks, easing stress for puppies as well as senior animals managing chronic conditions. Pet owners describe feeling confident that their animals are in gentle and capable hands throughout their visits.

title.en: Effective chronic management alongside mixed diagnoses

text.en: Treatment outcomes receive mixed reviews across different clinical situations. Long-term clients credit the hospital with successfully managing chronic canine heart conditions for years and providing effective routine veterinary care. Conversely, a couple of dissatisfied owners report poor outcomes with feline patients, citing unresolved symptoms or feeling that expensive tests were emphasized over immediate symptom relief.

q.en: Does the clinic treat long-term chronic conditions?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviewers note successful long-term management of chronic conditions, including heart disease in dogs.

q.en: How does the team support families during end-of-life care?

a.en: Clients describe compassionate end-of-life support, noting that staff handle pets with dignity and send handwritten sympathy cards to grieving families.

q.en: Are weekend or holiday appointments available?

a.en: Clients report that the hospital has accommodated urgent visits during holiday weekends when other local clinics were closed.
